property.coverage_basis: Units built on or before June 13, 1979 that are not single-family dwellings generally have both rent control and eviction protection under the SF Rent Ordinance.

anonymization.policy: All tenant names are replaced with role labels. Dates and dollar amounts are unchanged, because the rent math depends on them.

arithmetic_notes: Percentages are added, never compounded. Source S04 and S05.
The dollar amount is the total percentage multiplied by the CURRENT base rent, not by each year's rent. Source S04.
No rounding up to the nearest dollar is permitted. Source S01.
Unit 1 check: 3995 x 0.016 = 63.92 exactly; 3995 x 0.030 = 119.85 exactly.
Unit 2 check: 3150 x 0.131 = 412.65 exactly; 3150 x 0.016 = 50.40 exactly.

differential.explanation: The maximum lawful increase differs sharply between the two units even though they are in the same building, because the legal ceiling is a function of each tenancy's own history of skipped increases - not of the unit's size, condition, or market rent.
